bilibili.title: iPhone 到机器人仿真：real2simcapture 开源了，哪些环节还没跑通？
bilibili.description:
扫描外观只是开始，机器人仿真还需要尺度、碰撞几何和物理参数来源。real2simcapture 已按 Apache-2.0 开源：这期用实际源码与空工作台介绍原生采集、Live 网格传输、Web 检查和 MJCF / URDF / USD 导出。当前为开发预览，真机签名安装、连续扫描和目标引擎闭环待验收，不提供签名 App。本片不是扫描效果演示，中文旁白为合成语音。
源码：https://github.com/eust-w/real2simcapture

youtube.title: real2simcapture Is Open Source | iPhone-to-Simulation Developer Preview
youtube.description:
An open-source capture and simulation-asset pipeline for robotics developers. This source-based introduction covers native iPhone capture, periodic ARKit mesh uploads, a Web workbench, and MJCF / URDF / USD export.

Apache-2.0 source: https://github.com/eust-w/real2simcapture

This is a developer preview, not a physical-device scanning demo. Device signing, continuous scanning and target-engine acceptance remain pending. No signed installable iPhone app is distributed. Estimated physical parameters are not measurements. Actual code and an empty workbench are shown; no fabricated scan results. Includes synthesized Mandarin narration, with Chinese and English subtitle files.
